$schema.description: A link to this schema, for editors; ignored by the IDE.

formatVersion.description: The version of the format: always 1.

id.description: The stable id other themes name as their parent; made from the name when it is left out.

name.description: The name shown in the theme list.

parent.description: The id of the theme this one changes; Zen Dark when it is left out.

syntax.description: Code styles: a colour, or a colour with a background and font style.

Color.description: A colour: #RGB, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, in hexadecimal digits of either case.

annotation.old.description: Blame annotations of the oldest commits in the gutter.

annotation.recent.description: Blame annotations of the newest commits in the gutter; older ones fade towards annotation.old.

bracket.matched.background.description: The background of the bracket next to the caret and of the bracket that matches it.

bracket.matched.foreground.description: The bracket next to the caret and the bracket that matches it.

bracket.unmatched.background.description: The background of the bracket next to the caret when nothing matches it.

bracket.unmatched.foreground.description: The bracket next to the caret when nothing matches it.

breakpoint.description: A line breakpoint in the gutter, drawn over the line number.

breakpoint.disabled.description: The outline of a disabled line breakpoint in the gutter.

completion.constant.description: The mark of a constant or enum member in the completion list.

completion.field.description: The mark of a field or property in the completion list.

completion.function.description: The mark of a function, method or constructor in the completion list.

completion.interface.description: The mark of an interface or type parameter in the completion list.

completion.keyword.description: The mark of a keyword in the completion list.

completion.module.description: The mark of a module or package in the completion list.

completion.other.description: The mark of any other kind of item in the completion list.

completion.snippet.description: The mark of a snippet in the completion list.

completion.type.description: The mark of a struct, class or enum in the completion list.

completion.variable.description: The mark of a variable or value in the completion list.

coverage.covered.description: The coverage mark in the gutter of a line the tests ran, and its line in the HTML report.

coverage.notCovered.description: The coverage mark in the gutter of a line the tests did not run.

coverage.partly.description: The coverage mark in the gutter of a line the tests ran only partly: some of its parts or branches did not run.

diagnostic.hint.description: A hint, or a problem of unknown severity.

diagnostic.typo.description: A misspelt word, from the spelling inspection: its wavy line and its mark.

diff.deleted.description: The background of a deleted line in the diff viewer.

diff.deletedWord.description: The background of the changed words of a deleted line in the diff viewer.

diff.filler.description: The filler rows of the diff viewer across from lines the other side does not have.

diff.inserted.description: The background of an inserted line in the diff viewer.

diff.insertedWord.description: The background of the changed words of an inserted line in the diff viewer.

diff.modified.description: The background of a modified line in the diff viewer.

diff.modifiedWord.description: The background of the changed words of a modified line in the diff viewer.

execution.arrow.description: The arrow in the gutter at the line where the debugger stopped.

execution.line.description: The background of the line where the debugger stopped.

fold.arrow.description: The fold arrows in the gutter.

fold.marker.description: The background of a folded region's mark.

fold.text.description: The text of a folded region's mark.

foreground.description: Text that is not highlighted, such as a folded region's tail or a preview.

gutter.added.description: The change marker in the gutter of lines added since the last commit.

gutter.deleted.description: The change marker in the gutter where lines were deleted since the last commit.

gutter.modified.description: The change marker in the gutter of lines modified since the last commit.

gutter.separator.description: The thin line between the gutter and the text.

indentGuide.description: The thin vertical lines at each indent level.

indentGuide.selected.description: The indent guide of the block the caret is in.

inlayHint.background.description: The background of an inlay hint, such as a parameter name before an argument.

inlayHint.foreground.description: The text of an inlay hint.

methodSeparator.description: The thin line above each top-level declaration while Show method separators is on.

rightMargin.description: The vertical line at the right margin and the visual guides of the code style.

search.mark.description: The marks of search matches by the scroll bar.

stickyLines.background.description: The background of the sticky lines over the top of the editor.

stickyLines.border.description: The line under the sticky lines.

symbolHighlight.description: The background of the name at the caret and of its other occurrences in the file, and of the places the symbol is read.

symbolHighlight.write.description: The background of the places the symbol at the caret is written: declared, assigned or changed.

unused.description: Unused code, such as an unused requirement or import: drawn in this colour instead of underlined.

whitespace.description: The dots of spaces and the marks of tabs while whitespaces are shown.

StyleObject.description: A code style with more than a colour.

StyleValue.description: A code style: a colour, or an object with the colour and a font style.

anyOf.description: A colour with a background or a font style.

code.description: Code inside a markup language: inline code and code blocks.

default.description: Code that no other key covers.

docComment.name.description: The name a documentation comment starts with, such as `Open` in `// Open opens a file`.

emphasis.description: Emphasised text in a markup language.

function.description: A function name in a definition or call.

globalVariable.description: A global variable, such as `console`, `window` or a module-level variable.

heading.description: A heading in a markup language, such as `# Title` in Markdown.

lifetime.description: A lifetime or label, such as `'a`.

link.description: A link's text in a markup language.

navigationLink.description: The name under the pointer while ⌘ (Ctrl) is held, which a click goes to.

property.description: A property or field where it is declared, such as `name` in `{ name: string }`.

semantic.builtinType.description: A built-in type, from the language server.

semantic.call.description: A call of a function or a method, from the language server; declarations keep `function`.

semantic.package.description: A package name, from the language server.

semantic.type.description: A type that is not built in, from the language server.

strong.description: Strong text in a markup language.

todo.description: TODO text in a comment, as the patterns of Settings → Editor → TODO find it.

type.description: A type or trait name, as the highlighter sees it.

ansi.description: The 16 ANSI colours: black, red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, cyan, white, then the bright ones; `null` keeps the parent's.

accent.description: The accent: primary buttons, focused fields, the active stripe button.

accent.foreground.description: Text on the accent colour, such as a primary button's label.

banner.background.description: Editor notifications, the banner above the editor.

button.secondary.border.description: The outline of a secondary button.

icon.run.description: The Run button and other run icons.

image.checker.dark.description: The dark squares of the board behind transparent images.

image.checker.light.description: The light squares of the board behind transparent images.

island.background.description: The raised panels: tool windows and the frame of the editor.

list.hover.description: A hovered row or button in a panel.

list.selection.description: A selected row in a list or tree.

popup.background.description: Popups, menus and dialogs, which float a step lighter than the window.

popup.border.description: The outline of popups, menus and dialogs.

popup.code.background.description: The background of code in documentation popups.

popup.hover.description: A hovered item in a popup or menu.

popup.shadow.description: The shadow under popups and dialogs.

project.0.description: The first project colour: a project's badge and the glow of the main toolbar.

project.foreground.description: The initials on a project's badge.

searchHighlight.description: The background of the part of a label that matches a search, as in the Settings dialog.

stripe.active.icon.description: The icon of the active tool window stripe button.

tab.active.background.description: The fill of the active editor tab.

tab.active.border.description: The outline of the active editor tab.

tab.border.description: Borders of tabs, tool bars and panels.

tab.modified.description: The name of an editor tab with unsaved changes.

text.error.description: Error messages in dialogs and settings.

text.secondary.description: Secondary text: paths, hints, status bar items, inactive icons.

text.warning.description: Warnings in dialogs and settings, such as a shortcut conflict.

textField.background.description: The inside of a text field in a dialog.

textField.border.description: The outline of a text field that has no focus.

textField.caret.description: The caret in a text field.

textField.selection.description: Selected text in a text field.

tree.excluded.background.description: The row of an excluded folder in the project tree.

tree.excluded.text.description: Excluded folders, such as build output, in the project tree; also invalid input.

tree.testRow.description: The row of a test file in the project tree.

vcs.added.description: A new file added to version control.

vcs.currentBranch.description: The label icon of the current branch, in the branches popup.

vcs.graph.0.description: The first lane colour of the log graph.

vcs.graph.1.description: The second lane colour of the log graph.

vcs.graph.2.description: The third lane colour of the log graph.

vcs.graph.3.description: The fourth lane colour of the log graph.

vcs.graph.4.description: The fifth lane colour of the log graph.

vcs.graph.5.description: The sixth lane colour of the log graph.

vcs.incoming.description: The count of commits to pull, in the branches popup.

vcs.modified.description: A file changed since the last commit: its name in the project tree, the tabs and the change lists.

vcs.outgoing.description: The count of commits to push, in the branches popup.

vcs.unversioned.description: A file not known to version control.

window.background.description: The window behind the panels: the main toolbar, the stripes and the status bar.

oneOf.description: A wavy line, as under a misspelt word.
